content.title: 技艺递进｜原料变形到成品特写
content.summary: 先给出单一原料，再用功能不同且难度递增的手部操作连续改变其形态；一次明确热处理完成不可逆转折，随后快速装盘，并用成品微距证明前面所有动作得到结果。

quick_start.input_format: 单一原料 + 至少3种功能不同的形变操作 + 1次不可逆加工 + 成品组装 + 保留前序痕迹的微距终证
quick_start.recommended_input: 太阳帆修复师把同一束植物纤维拉伸、分条、编织并张紧到六边形框，只热压一次完成封合，最后用微距证明成品膜仍保留拉伸、编织和封合痕迹。
required_anchors: Establish one raw material and its maker before complex manipulation.
Use at least three functionally different manipulations that visibly change the same material.
Cross one visible irreversible processing threshold before the result assembly.
End on a macro finished-state proof that retains visible evidence of earlier transformations.
usage_steps: 把示例主体、场景和表层元素替换为原创概念。
让每个必需锚点和 Creative DNA 不可变条件都能在画面因果链中被看见。
选择 MiniMax H3 或 Seedance 2.0 模板，只填写已声明的可替换项。
生成前检查时长、事件顺序、镜头连续性、声音和反复制约束。
applicable_scope: 先给出单一原料，再用功能不同且难度递增的手部操作连续改变其形态；一次明确热处理完成不可逆转折，随后快速装盘，并用成品微距证明前面所有动作得到结果。
能够保留全部必需锚点的原创 4–15 秒短片。
需要可复用因果视频结构的 MiniMax H3 或 Seedance 2.0 项目。
not_suitable_for: 要求复制来源人物、场景、道具、对白或镜头顺序的任务。
无法在目标时长内展示全部必需锚点的概念。
缺少紧凑因果链的长篇讲解或无关多地点叙事。

creative_dna.mechanism: 把旧成品拆成可追踪部件，再按骨架、表皮、软垫的功能顺序重建；第一人称双手只触发必要步骤，最终以触摸和完整广角证明新成品。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: The original object is established before reversible disassembly.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "The original object is established before reversible disassembly."

invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Every separated component stays traceable."

invariants.rule: Structure is completed before surface finish.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Structure is completed before surface finish."

invariants.rule: Operator hands trigger rather than obscure the work.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Operator hands trigger rather than obscure the work."

invariants.rule: The ending includes tactile and full-object proof.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The ending includes tactile and full-object proof."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: all source faces, bodies, wardrobe, identities and creator-specific character designs
the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
